# Habitat: a long module (8-sided cylinder lying along X) on two skids, a dome module joined by a
# tunnel, glowing window strips and a door screen, and a beacon whose arm spins on the long
# module's roof (rigid, one turn per 2 s, linear). Up Z, facing -Y.
new
material new Hull --base-color 0.302 0.502 0.380
material new Trim --base-color 0.188 0.365 0.259 --no-slot
material new Glow --base-color 0.745 0.863 0.498 --emission 0.745 0.863 0.498 --no-slot
material new Beacon --base-color 0.933 1.0 0.8 --emission 0.933 1.0 0.8 --no-slot
# turned about its own axis first (a flat on top), then laid along X: Euler XYZ is extrinsic, so two steps
add mesh cylinder --name Module --vertices 8 --radius 0.7 --depth 2.6 --location -0.9 0 0.95 --rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Hull
add mesh cylinder --name EndL --vertices 8 --radius 0.56 --depth 0.24 --location -2.3 0 0.95 --rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name SkidF --size 1 --location -0.9 -0.45 0.12
scale 2.2 0.18 0.24
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name SkidB --size 1 --location -0.9 0.45 0.12
scale 2.2 0.18 0.24
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Window --size 1 --location -1.0 -0.62 1.05
scale 1.6 0.12 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cylinder --name Tunnel --vertices 6 --radius 0.36 --depth 1.0 --location 0.75 0 0.6 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Trim
# the dome: the upper half of a 10 x 6 sphere, 2 m across, on a short ring wall
add mesh uv-sphere --name Dome --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 1.0 --location 1.9 0 0.4
material assign Hull
active Dome
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.01"
delete
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Ring --vertices 10 --radius 1.04 --depth 0.4 --location 1.9 0 0.2
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Door --size 1 --location 1.9 -0.98 0.5
scale 0.5 0.16 0.62
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name Porthole --size 1 --location 1.9 -0.62 1.02
scale 0.34 0.4 0.2
apply --scale
set rotation 45 0 0
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location -0.4 0 1.85
scale 0.14 0.14 0.4
apply --scale
material assign Trim
# the spinning beacon arm: origin on the post's axis
add mesh cube --name Spinner --size 1 --location -0.4 0 2.08
scale 0.7 0.12 0.1
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name SpinLight --size 0.18 --location -0.1 0 2.12
material assign Beacon
select Spinner SpinLight
active Spinner
join
cursor set -0.4 0 2.08
origin set --to cursor
select all
shade flat
fps 24
frame range 0 48
select Spinner
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 0
set rotation 0 0 360
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 48
keyframe interpolation linear --all
frame set 0
export habitat.glb --bake-animations
